capability.title: Product catalog management
capability.description: Creates and manages localized product records, media, permissions, activation, storefront detail pages and structured product data.

capability.title: Product categories
capability.description: Organizes products in hierarchical categories with category-specific fields, storefront pages, lists and filters.

capability.title: Product attributes
capability.description: Defines reusable and product-specific fields for localized content, specifications, selectable attributes and customer input.

capability.title: Product variants
capability.description: Generates and manages parent-child product variants with selectable attributes, inherited fields and default variants.

capability.title: Digital products
capability.description: Provides a non-physical product type for download- or access-based items that do not require shipping.

capability.title: Product pricing
capability.description: Models base, retail and offer prices together with quantity tiers, time-period pricing, VAT and configurable price factors.

capability.title: E-commerce tracking
capability.description: Emits product list views, product detail views and product selections to the configured e-commerce data layer.
